_source: Microsoft Entra v1 token endpoint (client credentials) and Store submission API GET /v1.0/my/applications answers, in Microsoft's published shapes (learn.microsoft.com/windows/uwp/monetize/create-and-manage-submissions-using-windows-store-services, learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/reference-error-codes). Ids and names are fictional.

body.error_description: AADSTS7000222: The provided client secret keys for app '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' are expired. Visit the Azure portal to create new keys for your app.
AADSTS7000215: Invalid client secret provided. Ensure the secret being sent in the request is the client secret value, not the client secret ID.
AADSTS700016: Application with identifier '...' was not found in the directory '...'.
